comment: The facts that the release checks run and the release record states, in one place (CAPA-0007): tools/release_checks.sh, ci/run_all.sh and tools/release_record.py read them from here, and tools/test_release_record.py checks that none of them keeps a copy. A change to a fact is a change to the release checks: it needs the SDP's section 6 and a change request when the checks it names change.
